question: Which of the five has been most explicit about serving mass-affluent clients, and what exactly have they said?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James launched Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, which integrate traditional and alternative investments within risk-based portfolios for financial advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients, per the firm.
items.quote: Raymond James Financial has introduced Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, which integrate traditional and alternative investments within risk-based portfolios for financial advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients, the firm said.

items.text: Tash Elwyn, Private Client Group President, stated the firm is committed to being a destination for private wealth advisors and the clients they serve, adding that individuals and families with significant wealth require truly personal advice backed by the right resources.
items.quote: "At Raymond James, we're committed to being a destination for private wealth advisors and the clients they serve. Individuals and families with significant wealth require truly personal advice, backed by the right resources, to navigate their financial opportunities and complexities," Raymond James Private Client Group President Tash Elwyn said in a statement.

items.text: The firm has been building out its private wealth platform with the new model portfolio product, described as the latest move in its push to capture a larger share of the high-net-worth advisory market.
items.quote: Raymond James is building out its private wealth platform with a new model portfolio product that blends traditional and alternative investments, the latest move in the firm's push to capture a larger share of the high-net-worth advisory market.

items.text: Nearly 450 advisors have earned the Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation as of September 2026, according to the firm; the program is for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets.
items.quote: As of September 2026, nearly 450 advisors have earned the designation, according to Raymond James. The program has been a key recruitment and retention signal for the firm as it competes for advisors who build practices around affluent households.
items.definition: advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets

items.text: The firm's Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched in September 2022, provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: Underpinning the platform is the firm's Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched in September 2022, which provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets.
items.definition: advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry stated the firm's private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform support advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: For example, our private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform supports advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients.

items.text: The firm states it brings the best of the firm to high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients through its Wealth Strategies offering in RIA custody services.
items.quote: Wealth Strategies: Bring the best of our firm to your high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients

items.text: Tash Elwyn, president of the Private Client Group, said the firm is committed to being a destination for private wealth advisors and the clients they serve, and that Private Wealth Guided Portfolios help advisors bring alternative investments to clients with significant wealth.
items.quote: "At Raymond James, we're committed to being a destination for private wealth advisors and the clients they serve," said Tash Elwyn, president of the firm's Private Client Group.

cells.reason: Multiple recent passages state Raymond James's targeting of high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth (mass-affluent and above) clients, including new product launches and executive quotes.
